brand.name: Performance Pulse
brand.tone: Professional, Objective, Functional, Clean, Business Dashboard

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Mode B (Control Room Grid). Dense, pixel-perfect usage, strictly functional.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6
layout_and_spacing.card: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-md shadow-sm p-4 md:p-6 flex flex-col
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: w-64 bg-white border-r border-slate-200 h-screen fixed flex flex-col z-10
layout_and_spacing.main_content: ml-0 md:ml-64 p-6 md:p-8 min-h-screen bg-slate-50
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align dense content and tables. Use generous padding inside containers.

buttons.primary: bg-blue-800 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:ring-offset-2
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors

badges.base: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium

tables.wrapper: w-full overflow-x-auto border border-slate-200 rounded-md bg-white
tables.header: bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider py-3 px-4

forms.input: w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-md shadow-sm px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 bg-white
forms.label: block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1

iconography.instruction: Use lucide-react icons exclusively. Avoid emojis completely. Ensure consistent stroke-width (usually 2) and sizing (w-4 h-4 or w-5 h-5 for inline, w-8 h-8 for empty states).

accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='login-submit-button'`). This applies to inputs, buttons, tables, and links.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Focus states must be clearly visible.
accessibility.motion: Use minimal micro-interactions only (hover, focus, subtle entrance). Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

pages_instructions.login_signup: Clean, centered auth card on a slate-50 background. Simple form with clear labels and a primary action button.
pages_instructions.waiting_approval: Empty state layout with a clock/hourglass icon, informing the user their account is pending admin review.
pages_instructions.access_denied: Empty state layout with a shield or lock icon in red/slate, informing the user they lack permissions.
pages_instructions.employee_dashboard: Greeting at the top. Main focus is the 'Submit Today's Report' form. Show a list of recent personal reports below it.
pages_instructions.admin_dashboard: Metrics cards at the top (Total Users, Pending Approvals). Actionable tables for User Management and Recent Reports Review.
pages_instructions.boss_dashboard: High-level metrics: Total/Active Employees, Reports Today, Missing Reports. A summary table or list of 'Missing Today'. Emphasis on tracking and missing data.
pages_instructions.employee_profile: Detailed view for Admin/Boss to see an employee's history, role, status, and weekly performance summary with a clean bento-grid layout.

media.instruction: No external image assets required for this internal tool interface. Focus on clean typography, white space, and clear data visualization.
